scholarships.title: Daet LGU Academic Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.description: For deserving students from Daet who are enrolled in any college degree program. Awarded to students who demonstrate academic excellence and financial need.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 5,000 per semester + school supplies allowance

scholarships.title: Labo Municipal Scholarship Grant
scholarships.description: Open to all bonafide residents of Labo pursuing undergraduate studies. Priority given to students from low-income families.

scholarships.title: Vinzons Youth Development Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for youth residents of Vinzons enrolled in any recognized higher education institution. Aimed at developing the youth workforce of the municipality.

scholarships.title: Capalonga Municipal Education Assistance
scholarships.description: Education assistance program for Capalonga residents in financial need. Supports students in continuing their college education without interruption.

scholarships.title: Jose Panganiban Scholars Program
scholarships.description: For residents of Jose Panganiban pursuing technology and vocational courses. Prioritizes students aligned with the municipality's mining and industrial development goals.

scholarships.title: Mercedes Municipal Scholarship Award
scholarships.description: Annual scholarship for academically outstanding students who are residents of Mercedes and enrolled in any state college or university.

scholarships.title: Paracale Gold Scholars Grant
scholarships.description: Scholarship grant for Paracale residents pursuing undergraduate degrees. Named in honor of the municipality's gold mining heritage and commitment to education.

scholarships.title: San Lorenzo Ruiz Educational Assistance Program
scholarships.description: In honor of the patron saint of the municipality, this program supports financially challenged students from San Lorenzo Ruiz in pursuing higher education.

scholarships.title: Santa Elena Academic Scholarship
scholarships.description: For bonafide residents of Santa Elena who are enrolled full-time in any CHED-recognized institution. Subject to good moral character and financial need assessment.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 4,000 per semester + miscellaneous fee coverage

scholarships.title: Talisay Municipal Education Grant
scholarships.description: Education grant for deserving students from Talisay. Covers basic tuition and living allowance to help students focus on their studies.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 3,500 per semester + PHP 1,000 monthly living allowance

scholarships.title: Basud Youth Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: For young residents of Basud who wish to pursue college education. Encourages youth participation in higher learning and community development.

scholarships.title: Camarines Norte Provincial Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: Province-wide scholarship open to all residents of Camarines Norte. Covers students from all 12 municipalities pursuing any undergraduate degree in a recognized institution.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 6,000 per semester + PHP 2,000 book allowance
